units.source_text: 我倚靠在究竟顶的栏杆上。

en.t: I leaned against the railing at the top of Kukkyōchō.
The wind was blowing from the southeast.

units.source_text: 上空还没有出现什么变化。

en.t: There was still no change in the sky above.

units.source_text: 镜湖地的水草上闪烁着月光，虫声和蛙鸣此起彼伏，占据着四周。

en.t: Moonlight shimmered on the water plants of Kyōkochi Pond, while the voices of insects and the croaking of frogs rose and fell, filling the surroundings.
